Subject: SIG v2.1 notice & delta questions

Hi Naomi,

We received notice that SIG v2.1 will include several new control clarifications around key management and data segregation. Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept the v2.1 re-answers window (60 days) for our upcoming procurement? Also, can you identify an internal owner for the delta items so we can coordinate evidence collection?

We attached the vendor-facing delta summary from CloudTrust for reference.

Thanks,
Lucia Perez
Information Security Manager
Acme Analytics

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-15T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v2.1 notice & delta questions

Hi Lucia — thanks for the heads up and the delta summary. We can commit to the 60-day re-answer window for Acme's procurement timeline.

Ownership: I'll put Ben and Monica on point for the SIG v2.1 delta items. High-level plan:
- Ben will map the changed questions to our existing evidence artifacts and identify gaps.
- Monica will collect the requested artifacts (config snippets, KMS policy extracts, retention logs) and package them with a short summary for each control.
- Karthik will review any technical re-answers that require runtime/architecture clarifications.

We should have a preliminary gap list by EOD 2027-09-16 and a packaged evidence bundle by 2027-09-22. Does that timeline work for Acme?

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Naomi / Lucia / Monica —

Quick update from my side after an initial pass against the v2.1 diff: there are 18 changed/clarified questions. Rough breakdown: 7 KMS/key lifecycle items, 5 multi-tenant/data segregation clarifications, 4 logging/retention specifics, 2 minor governance wording changes.

I've created a delta CSV (attached) that maps each changed question to: current answer, owner, candidate evidence items, and a risk note where we might need a re-answer rather than a straight evidence upload. Early observations:
- KMS: we already have HSM/KMS integration docs for Dedicated customers; need to extract a sanitized key rotation timeline.
- Data segregation: need a brief diagram (sanitized) showing tenant isolation and route policies for Dedicated vs Hosted.
- Logging: retention buckets exist but retention policy text needs a clearer retention-by-channel table.

Next steps (my commitments):
1) Produce gap list CSV by 2027-09-16 17:00 PT (attached as SIG_v2.1-diff.csv).
2) Upload curated artifacts into a shared drive and produce an evidence-pack ZIP by 2027-09-22.
3) Flag any re-answer candidates to Karthik for technical write-ups by 2027-09-18.

Attachments: SIG_v2.1-diff.csv (csv)

-Ben
Ben Carter
Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Lucia / Martin —

Confirming the timeline and next steps:
- 2027-09-16 EOD: Redwood provides the delta mapping (attached).
- 2027-09-18: Technical re-answer drafts from Karthik for flagged items.
- 2027-09-22: Final evidence bundle (evidence-pack-logs.zip) uploaded to the shared drive and link provided.
